summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing for FitX Global promotional site. 12/12 backend pytest cases pass. All requested frontend flows verified (hero, sections, store links, newsletter, contact, blog index, blog post, mobile menu, video attrs).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: NewsletterEntry/ContactEntry use string ISO timestamps via Field(default_factory) — fine, but consider native datetime with model serializer for consistency.
Idempotent newsletter handler correctly strips _id from existing Mongo doc before returning (good).
Blog data is hardcoded in server.py. Acceptable for promo site since it's a fixed seed of 6 posts, but if blog grows, move to a JSON/DB collection.
CORS uses allow_origins=* with allow_credentials=True — works but technically browsers ignore credentials when origin is *. Not impacting this promo-site flow.
seed_data_creation: Test newsletter/contact entries created with TEST_ prefix in MongoDB (newsletter_subscribers, contact_messages). No cleanup performed — harmless test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers: GET /api/, GET /api/blogs (list + category filter), GET /api/blogs/{slug} (200 + 404), POST /api/newsletter (success, idempotent, invalid email, persisted), POST /api/contact (success, short msg 400, invalid email 422). Frontend verified via Playwright on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Video element attributes verified via JS property access (HTML attribute may show None for boolean attrs but DOM property is True).
